Identity invariants: use the EXACT SAME adult grey mannequin identity, oval bald head, natural athletic build and muscle definition, body proportions, matte pale slate grey material, plain charcoal short training shorts and charcoal low-profile shoes as the reference. Same subdued studio lighting from upper left, flat very light cool-grey background #F3F5F7 with faint soft contact shadow, restrained premium 3D educational rendering. Exercise: INCLINE BARBELL BENCH PRESS, bottom position. A charcoal adjustable bench back pad at approximately 30 degrees above horizontal with short seat pad. Head, upper back and buttocks fully supported, both feet planted on floor. One continuous straight bar with modest matching graphite plate and collar on each end. Closed overhand grips slightly wider than shoulders; shaft gently contacts upper sternum BELOW collarbones, never at neck, near-straight wrists above bent elbows, forearms vertical relative to floor, elbows moderately tucked. Camera side-biased front three-quarter shows bench angle and bar-chest contact. Highlight both pectoralis major and anterior deltoid muscle regions in coral only; biceps/triceps remain grey.

revisions.reason: Independent review found shaft too close to base of neck
revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit/scientific-educational. Image 1 is edit target, original incline barbell bench press. Image 2 is canonical identity/style master. Keep identical model/body, bench angle, supported body, feet, camera, materials, charcoal shorts/shoes, coral chest/front-deltoid highlights, lighting and background. The bar should contact the upper sternum, below the existing bar position. Reposition both elbows/wrists together so closed overhand grips remain slightly wider than shoulders, wrists directly above elbows, forearms near vertical. revisions.result: Bar moved down onto upper coral pectoral region; elbows and wrists follow.

review.notes: Corrected shaft visibly below clavicles on upper pectoral region. Continuous bar, overhand grips, planted feet and bench/body preserved; bench angle approximate.
